youtube.title: Why Your Sink Has a Hole Near the Top 🚰 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The small hole near the top of most bathroom sinks is the overflow. If the plug is in and the tap is left running, water reaches that hole and flows down a channel built into the basin to the drain pipe, instead of spilling over the edge onto the floor. It also lets air into the drain as a full sink empties, which helps the water flow out faster. Clean it now and then, as it can collect grime.

Subscribe to The Hidden Why for a new why every day.
